basic_info.description: Welcome to 92 San Pablo Avenue, on the market for the first time in over 50 years. This cherished residence is a jewel in Saint Francis Wood, blending timeless elegance with modern updates. 92 San Pablo Avenue offers four bedrooms, three updated baths, a layout perfect for both family living and entertaining.   Elegant Interiors of a grand foyer with parquet floors and a sweeping staircase set the stage. A sunken living room, centered around the magnificent wood-burning fireplace, while the large dining room is ideal for hosting. The remodeled eat-in kitchen features premium appliances opening onto that ocean view sun room. A remodeled full bath and bedroom complete this level. The primary suite offers a dedicated dressing room and a renovated en-suite bath. There are 2 additional large bedrooms with sweeping ocean views and a full updated bath. Off of the foyer a stairway leads you to A versatile bonus room offering space for a media room, fifth bedroom or private office. Newer windows bring abundant natural light throughout. Just a few short blocks from West Portal's shops, cafes, and restaurants, including George's, Elena's, Little Joe's, and Noe Valley Bakery with convenient access to the transportation and 280 make this an ideal location
